vb_textbox.text: There are two pairs of gnomes, a brown and red pair and then a grey and purple pair. Within each pair try to work out which one is giving you a higher mushroom yield, this can take a few turns. The maximum yield you can get is 9 mushrooms. Once you've worked out which gives a higher yield keep selecting that one out of the pair, eventually the yield will begin to decrease. Once it gets to 2 or 1 mushrooms then start picking the other gnome in the pair. This can itself give a low yield so try a few turns and if the yield is still low go back to the other one.
